title: Braised Fennel and Bulb Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful vegetarian bowl dish made with tender fennel and bulb, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced fennel and sauté until tender and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the Brazilian-Style seasoning and stir to combine.
Pour in the light coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let braise for 10-12 minutes, or until the fennel is tender.
Serve the fennel mixture over a bed of rice or noodles in a bowl.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
